edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer as the sender via _msgSender, letting the caller drive transfer logic.
unlock() compares msg.sender against _previousOwner to regain ownership.
block.timestamp determines the cooldown windows enforced inside _transfer.
randtime builds its seed from block.timestamp and other block values, making timing miner-manipulable.
randwallet draws from generateRandomNumber seeded with block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline and to reset LastShuffle.
lock() computes _lockTime as now + time, a timestamp-dependent ownership lock.
Randomness primitives consume block.timestamp, so outcomes are predictable by miners.
_transfer invokes the pseudo random generation path through randwallet/randtime for lottery selection.
_transfer branches on sender/recipient equal to owner() to skip limits and cooldown.
timestamp mapping is written on buys and read to enforce the per-address cooldown.
_CoolDown is added to block.timestamp when arming the cooldown for a buyer.
tradingEnabled gates transfers involving the Uniswap pair.
LastShuffle is compared and reset to decide when to run the lottery.
TimeBetweenShuffle bounds the lottery interval checked in _transfer.
RandReturned indexes _DevLotteryWallets to choose the new dev wallet.
_devWalletAddress is the destination of the dev ETH payout.
_sharedWalletAddress is the destination of the shared ETH payout.
uniswapV2Pair comparisons distinguish buys from sells and skip cooldown/weight logic.
swapEnabled guards the automatic swap and ETH payout block.
feeEnabled guards lottery and dev-list bookkeeping.
_isBlackListedBot blocks sender and recipient, a centralized censorship control.
_maxTxAmount is enforced as transfer cap and used to clamp the swap amount.
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer before updating allowance.
_transfer finishes by invoking _tokenTransfer with the computed takeFee flag.
_transfer triggers randwallet when the shuffle interval elapses.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth, performing an external router interaction before finishing state updates.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to wallets immediately after the external swap.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap that moves tokens out of the contract.
sendETHTodev executes native ETH transfers to external wallets.
AllowDex calls the external router addLiquidityETH with the contract balance.
AllowDex writes the _tradingEnabled parameter into the tradingEnabled state variable.
Constructor sets _owner from _msgSender at deployment.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner after the checks.
lock() moves _owner out and stores it in _previousOwner.
_transferStandard subtracts/ adds reflected balances in _rOwned relying on SafeMath for overflow safety.
_rTotal rate feeds _getValues used by _transferStandard for reflection math.
The router swap transfers tokens to/from the pair; pair token hooks can re-enter _transfer before balances settle.
Native ETH transfer executes recipient fallback code which may re-enter contract entry points.
amount parameter is validated and then used in fee/reflection arithmetic inside _transfer.
sender parameter drives blacklist, cooldown, pair and dev-list decisions.
recipient parameter drives blacklist, max-tx, cooldown and lottery eligibility checks.
contractTokenBalance is clamped to _maxTxAmount and compared against the swap threshold.
takeFee toggles removeAllFee/restoreAllFee around the token transfer.
tokenAmount is approved to the router and swapped.
totalCummulatives sums weights and is used as modulus in winner selection.
index is decremented while walking lottery weights, an arithmetic-heavy loop.
time parameter is added to now to set _lockTime.
_tradingEnabled parameter controls whether trading is enabled after liquidity setup.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a transient parameter fully consumed by the _transfer validation and fee arithmetic.
sender only exists to parameterize the internal _transfer logic.
recipient only exists to parameterize the internal _transfer logic.
local balance snapshot used solely to decide the swap inside _transfer.
takeFee is a local flag passed into _tokenTransfer to toggle fee removal.
tokenAmount has no meaning outside swapTokensForEth.
totalCummulatives is an accumulator local to randwallet.
index is a loop-local cursor used only inside randwallet.
time is only used to compute _lockTime within lock().
_tradingEnabled is written straight into the tradingEnabled state during AllowDex.
